description: The line plot illustrates the relative change in performance across different layers of the Llama-3-8B-Instruct model when applying layer-wise quantized pruning using the SnapKV method, with a baseline of 4 KV tokens at 4-bit precision. The x-axis represents the model layers, grouped into five intervals: Layer1-4, Layer5-12, Layer13-20, Layer21-28, and Layer29-32, indicating that configurations are modified every 4 layers for the initial and final layers and every 8 layers for the intermediate ones. The y-axis shows the relative change in performance, ranging from -15% to 5%, with a horizontal dashed line at 0% indicating the baseline performance. Four configurations are compared: LB-Avg of 2×tokens,8-bit (yellow line with circular markers), LB-Avg of 1×tokens,16-bit (red line with square markers), RULER4k of 2×tokens,8-bit (light blue line with circular markers), and RULER4k of 1×tokens,16-bit (dark blue line with square markers). The LB-Avg of 2×tokens,8-bit configuration shows a slight increase in relative change from approximately -1% to around 1%. The LB-Avg of 1×tokens,16-bit configuration remains relatively stable, fluctuating between approximately -2% and 1%. The RULER4k of 2×tokens,8-bit configuration starts at around -1%, decreases to approximately -7% at Layer13-20, and then increases back to around 0%. The RULER4k of 1×tokens,16-bit configuration starts at around -1%, decreases to approximately -15% at Layer13-20, further decreases to around -12% at Layer21-28, and then increases to approximately -3% at Layer29-32.
